recipes.name: Classic Margherita Pizza
ingredients: Pizza dough
Tomato sauce
Fresh mozzarella cheese
Fresh basil leaves
Olive oil
Salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 475°F (245°C).
Roll out the pizza dough and spread tomato sauce evenly.
Top with slices of fresh mozzarella and fresh basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Slice and serve hot.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Stir-Fry
ingredients: Tofu, cubed
Broccoli florets
Carrots, sliced
Bell peppers, sliced
Soy sauce
Ginger, minced
Garlic, minced
Sesame oil
Cooked rice for serving
instructions: In a wok, heat sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add minced ginger and garlic, sauté until fragrant.
Add cubed tofu and stir-fry until golden brown.
Add broccoli, carrots, and bell peppers. Cook until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Pour soy sauce over the stir-fry and toss to combine.
Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: All-purpose flour
Butter, softened
Brown sugar
White sugar
Eggs
Vanilla extract
Baking soda
Salt
Chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a bowl, cream together softened butter, brown sugar, and white sugar.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
Combine flour, baking soda, and salt. Gradually add to the wet ingredients.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until edges are golden brown.
Allow cookies to cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Chicken Alfredo Pasta
ingredients: Fettuccine pasta
Chicken breast, sliced
Heavy cream
Parmesan cheese, grated
Garlic, minced
Butter
Salt and pepper to taste
Fresh parsley for garnish
instructions: Cook fettuccine pasta according to package instructions.
In a pan, sauté sliced chicken in butter until fully cooked.
Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant.
Pour in heavy cream and grated Parmesan cheese. Stir until the cheese is melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Combine the Alfredo sauce with cooked pasta.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.

recipes.name: Mango Salsa Chicken
ingredients: Chicken thighs
Mango, diced
Red onion, finely chopped
Cilantro, chopped
Lime juice
Jalapeño, minced
Salt and pepper to taste
Cooked rice for serving
instructions: Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper.
Grill or bake chicken until fully cooked.
In a bowl, combine diced mango, chopped red onion, cilantro, minced jalapeño, and lime juice.
Dice the cooked chicken and mix it with the mango salsa.
Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.name: Quinoa Salad with Avocado
ingredients: Quinoa, cooked
Avocado, diced
Cherry tomatoes, halved
Cucumber, diced
Red bell pepper, diced
Feta cheese, crumbled
Lemon vinaigrette dressing
Salt and pepper to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cooked quinoa, diced avocado, halved cherry tomatoes, diced cucumber, diced red bell pepper, and crumbled feta cheese.
Drizzle with lemon vinaigrette dressing and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Chill in the refrigerator before serving.

recipes.name: Tomato Basil Bruschetta
ingredients: Baguette, sliced
Tomatoes, diced
Fresh basil, chopped
Garlic cloves, minced
Balsamic glaze
Olive oil
Salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Place baguette slices on a baking sheet and toast in the oven until golden brown.
In a bowl, combine diced tomatoes, chopped fresh basil, minced garlic, and a drizzle of olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Top each toasted baguette slice with the tomato-basil mixture.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze before serving.

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
ingredients: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced
Broccoli florets
Soy sauce
Oyster sauce
Sesame oil
Garlic, minced
Ginger, minced
Cornstarch
Cooked white rice for serving
instructions: In a bowl, mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, and cornstarch to create the sauce.
In a wok, stir-fry thinly sliced beef until browned. Remove from the wok.
Stir-fry broccoli florets, minced garlic, and minced ginger in the same wok.
Add the cooked beef back to the wok and pour the sauce over the mixture.
Stir until everything is coated and heated through.
Serve over cooked white rice.

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
ingredients: Tomatoes, sliced
Fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced
Fresh basil leaves
Balsamic glaze
Extra virgin olive oil
Salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Arrange alternating slices of tomatoes and fresh mozzarella on a serving platter.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the slices.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze and extra virgin olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately as a refreshing salad.

recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi Pasta
ingredients: Linguine pasta
Shrimp, peeled and deveined
Garlic, minced
White wine
Lemon juice
Red pepper flakes
Fresh parsley, chopped
Salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Cook linguine pasta according to package instructions.
In a skillet, sauté minced garlic in olive oil until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook until pink and opaque.
Pour in white wine and lemon juice. Simmer until the sauce slightly thickens.
Season with red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper.
Toss cooked linguine in the shrimp scampi sauce.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving.

recipes.name: Chicken Biryani
ingredients: Basmati rice
Chicken, cut into pieces
Onions, thinly sliced
Tomatoes, chopped
Yogurt
Ginger-garlic paste
Biryani masala
Green chilies, sliced
Fresh coriander leaves
Mint leaves
Ghee
Salt to taste
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, biryani masala, and salt.
In a pot, sauté sliced onions until golden brown. Remove half for later use.
Layer marinated chicken, chopped tomatoes, half of the fried onions, and rice in the pot.
Top with ghee, green chilies, fresh coriander leaves, mint leaves, and the remaining fried onions.
Cover and cook on low heat until the rice is fully cooked and aromatic.
Serve hot, garnished with additional coriander and mint leaves.

recipes.name: Chicken Karahi
ingredients: Chicken, cut into pieces
Tomatoes, chopped
Green chilies, sliced
Ginger, julienned
Garlic, minced
Coriander powder
Cumin powder
Red chili powder
Garam masala
Cooking oil
Fresh coriander leaves
Salt to taste
instructions: In a wok (karahi), heat cooking oil and sauté minced garlic until golden brown.
Add chicken pieces and cook until browned on all sides.
Add chopped tomatoes, green chilies, ginger, and spices. Cook until tomatoes are soft.
Cover and simmer until the chicken is tender and the oil separates from the masala.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with naan or rice.

recipes.name: Aloo Keema
ingredients: Ground beef
Potatoes, peeled and diced
Onions, finely chopped
Tomatoes, chopped
Ginger-garlic paste
Cumin powder
Coriander powder
Turmeric powder
Red chili powder
Cooking oil
Fresh coriander leaves
Salt to taste
instructions: In a pan, heat cooking oil and sauté chopped onions until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté until fragrant.
Add ground beef and cook until browned. Drain excess oil if needed.
Add diced potatoes, chopped tomatoes, and spices. Mix well.
Cover and simmer until the potatoes are tender and the masala is well-cooked.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with naan or rice.

recipes.name: Chapli Kebabs
ingredients: Ground beef
Onions, finely chopped
Tomatoes, finely chopped
Green chilies, chopped
Coriander leaves, chopped
Pomegranate seeds
Ginger-garlic paste
Cumin powder
Coriander powder
Red chili powder
Egg
Cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, mix ground beef, chopped onions, tomatoes, green chilies, coriander leaves, and pomegranate seeds.
Add ginger-garlic paste, cumin powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, and salt. Mix well.
Add an egg to bind the mixture and form into round flat kebabs.
Heat cooking oil in a pan and shallow fry the kebabs until browned on both sides.
Serve hot with naan or mint chutney.

recipes.name: Saag (Spinach) with Makki di Roti
ingredients: Mustard greens, washed and chopped
Spinach, washed and chopped
Cornmeal (makki ka atta)
Onions, finely chopped
Green chilies, chopped
Ginger, grated
Ghee
Salt to taste
instructions: Boil mustard greens and spinach until tender. Drain and blend into a coarse paste.
In a pan, sauté chopped onions, green chilies, and grated ginger in ghee until golden brown.
Add the greens paste and cook until it thickens.
Meanwhile, knead cornmeal with water to make a dough. Roll into rotis (flatbreads).
Cook the rotis on a griddle until golden brown.
Serve hot saag with makki di roti and a dollop of ghee.

recipes.name: Japanese Ramen Soup
ingredients: Ramen noodles
Chicken broth
Soy sauce
Mirin
Sesame oil
Shiitake mushrooms, sliced
Bok choy, chopped
Green onions, sliced
Soft-boiled eggs
Grilled chicken slices
Norwegian seaweed (nori)
instructions: Cook ramen noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a pot, combine chicken broth, soy sauce, mirin, and sesame oil. Bring to a simmer.
Add sliced shiitake mushrooms and chopped bok choy. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Divide the cooked noodles into serving bowls and ladle the hot broth over them.
Top with green onions, soft-boiled eggs, grilled chicken slices, and nori.
Serve hot and enjoy the authentic Japanese ramen!

recipes.name: Moroccan Chickpea Tagine
ingredients: Chickpeas, cooked
Tomatoes, chopped
Carrots, diced
Onions, finely chopped
Garlic, minced
Cumin
Coriander
Cinnamon
Paprika
Vegetable broth
Olives
Fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: In a tagine or large pot, sauté chopped onions and minced garlic until softened.
Add diced carrots, chopped tomatoes, and cooked chickpeas.
Season with cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and paprika. Stir to coat.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a simmer. Cook until carrots are tender.
Stir in olives and garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.
Serve this flavorful Moroccan dish with couscous or crusty bread.

recipes.name: Korean Bibimbap
ingredients: Cooked white rice
Beef bulgogi (marinated and grilled beef slices)
Carrots, julienned and sautéed
Spinach, blanched and seasoned
Zucchini, sliced and grilled
Bean sprouts, blanched
Fried egg
Gochujang (Korean red pepper paste)
Sesame oil
Toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Arrange cooked white rice in a bowl.
Top with beef bulgogi, sautéed carrots, seasoned spinach, grilled zucchini, and blanched bean sprouts.
Place a fried egg on top and drizzle with gochujang and sesame oil.
Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds before serving.
Mix everything together before enjoying this delicious Korean bibimbap!
Feel free to customize with additional vegetables or protein.

recipes.name: Greek Moussaka
ingredients: Eggplants, sliced
Ground lamb or beef
Onions, finely chopped
Garlic, minced
Tomatoes, crushed
Red wine
Cinnamon
Allspice
Nutmeg
Olive oil
Milk
Flour
Parmesan cheese
Egg yolks
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Sauté sliced eggplants in olive oil until browned. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook chopped onions and minced garlic until softened.
Add ground lamb or beef and brown. Stir in crushed tomatoes, red wine, and spices.
In a separate saucepan, make béchamel sauce: melt butter, whisk in flour, add milk, and cook until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan cheese and egg yolks.
In a baking dish, layer eggplants and meat mixture. Top with béchamel sauce.
Bake for 40-45 minutes until golden brown. Let it cool before slicing.
Serve slices of moussaka warm and enjoy this Greek classic!

recipes.name: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
ingredients: Chicken thighs, boneless and skinless
Yogurt
Ginger-garlic paste
Garam masala
Kashmiri red chili powder
Tomato puree
Butter
Heavy cream
Kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves)
Sugar
Salt to taste
instructions: Marinate chicken thighs in a mixture of yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, and Kashmiri red chili powder.
In a pan, melt butter and sauté the marinated chicken until browned.
Add tomato puree and cook until the oil separates. Stir in heavy cream.
Sprinkle kasuri methi, sugar, and salt. Simmer until the chicken is fully cooked.
Serve this creamy butter chicken over rice or with naan for an authentic Pakistani/Indian experience.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry
ingredients: Chicken thighs, boneless and skinless
Green curry paste
Coconut milk
Fish sauce
Sugar
Eggplant, sliced
Bell peppers, sliced
Basil leaves
Jasmine rice for serving
instructions: In a pot, simmer green curry paste in coconut milk.
Add chicken, fish sauce, and sugar. Cook until chicken is tender.
Stir in sliced eggplant and bell peppers. Simmer until vegetables are cooked.
Garnish with fresh basil leaves.
Serve hot over jasmine rice and enjoy this Thai classic!

recipes.name: Mango Lassi
ingredients: Ripe mango, peeled and diced
Yogurt
Milk
Honey
Cardamom powder
Ice cubes
instructions: In a blender, combine diced mango, yogurt, milk, honey, and cardamom powder.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Add ice cubes and blend again until the lassi is chilled.
Pour into glasses and garnish with a sprinkle of cardamom.
Enjoy this refreshing Mango Lassi!

recipes.name: Italian Tiramisu
ingredients: Espresso, brewed and cooled
Ladyfinger cookies
Mascarpone cheese
Heavy cream
Sugar
Cocoa powder
instructions: In a bowl, whip heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
In another bowl, mix mascarpone cheese and sugar until smooth.
Gently fold the whipped cream into the mascarpone mixture.
Dip ladyfinger cookies into brewed espresso and layer them in a serving dish.
Spread a layer of the mascarpone mixture over the cookies.
Repeat layers and finish with a dusting of cocoa powder.
Chill in the refrigerator for a few hours before serving.
Indulge in the decadence of this classic Italian Tiramisu!

recipes.name: Turkish Kebabs
ingredients: Ground lamb or beef
Onions, grated
Garlic, minced
Parsley, finely chopped
Cumin
Coriander
Red pepper flakes
Salt and pepper to taste
Flatbread for serving
Tahini sauce
instructions: In a bowl, mix ground meat, grated onions, minced garlic, chopped parsley, and spices.
Form the mixture into kebab shapes and grill until fully cooked.
Serve the kebabs on flatbread with a drizzle of tahini sauce.
Enjoy these flavorful Turkish Kebabs with your favorite sides.

recipes.name: Blueberry Banana Smoothie
ingredients: Blueberries, fresh or frozen
Banana, peeled and sliced
Greek yogurt
Almond milk
Honey
Chia seeds (optional)
instructions: In a blender, combine blueberries, banana, Greek yogurt, almond milk, and honey.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Add chia seeds for extra nutrition and blend briefly.
Pour into a glass and enjoy this nutritious Blueberry Banana Smoothie!

recipes.name: Mexican Street Corn (Elote)
ingredients: Corn on the cob
Mayonnaise
Cotija cheese, crumbled
Chili powder
Lime wedges
instructions: Grill or roast corn on the cob until kernels are charred.
Brush each cob with mayonnaise, then sprinkle with crumbled Cotija cheese and chili powder.
Serve with lime wedges for squeezing over the top.
Enjoy this delicious and flavorful Mexican Street Corn!

recipes.name: Russian Borscht
ingredients: Beets, peeled and shredded
Cabbage, shredded
Potatoes, diced
Onions, finely chopped
Carrots, grated
Tomato paste
Beef or vegetable broth
Garlic, minced
Bay leaves
Sour cream for serving
instructions: In a pot, sauté chopped onions and garlic until softened.
Add shredded beets, cabbage, diced potatoes, grated carrots, and tomato paste.
Pour in broth and add bay leaves. Simmer until vegetables are tender.
Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream on top.
Enjoy the hearty and comforting flavors of Russian Borscht!

recipes.name: South Indian Masala Dosa
ingredients: Dosa batter (fermented rice and urad dal batter)
Potatoes, boiled and mashed
Onions, finely chopped
Mustard seeds
Cumin seeds
Curry leaves
Turmeric powder
Green chilies, chopped
Ghee
Coconut chutney for serving
instructions: In a pan, heat ghee and add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, and curry leaves.
Add chopped onions, green chilies, and turmeric powder. Sauté until onions are golden brown.
Mix in boiled and mashed potatoes. Cook until well combined and seasoned.
Spread dosa batter on a hot griddle to make thin pancakes.
Place a spoonful of the potato mixture in the center, fold, and serve hot.
Pair with coconut chutney for a delicious South Indian meal.

recipes.name: Lebanese Falafel Wrap
ingredients: Falafel balls
Whole wheat or regular wraps
Tomatoes, diced
Cucumbers, sliced
Red onions, thinly sliced
Lettuce, shredded
Tahini sauce
Fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Warm falafel balls according to package instructions.
Place a generous serving of falafel in the center of each wrap.
Top with diced tomatoes, sliced cucumbers, red onions, shredded lettuce, and fresh parsley.
Drizzle with tahini sauce and wrap tightly.
Enjoy this Lebanese Falafel Wrap filled with fresh and flavorful ingredients!

recipes.name: Brazilian Caipirinha
ingredients: Cachaça (Brazilian sugarcane spirit)
Lime, cut into wedges
Granulated sugar
Ice cubes
instructions: In a glass, muddle lime wedges with granulated sugar to release the juice.
Fill the glass with ice cubes.
Pour cachaça over the ice and stir well.
Sip and enjoy the refreshing taste of the Brazilian Caipirinha!
Adjust sugar and lime to suit your taste preferences.

recipes.name: Spanish Patatas Bravas
ingredients: Potatoes, diced
Olive oil
Garlic, minced
Smoked paprika
Tomato sauce
Mayonnaise
Hot sauce
Fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss diced potatoes with olive oil, minced garlic, and smoked paprika. Roast until crispy.
In a small saucepan, heat tomato sauce, mayonnaise, and hot sauce. Stir until warm.
Drizzle the sauce over the roasted potatoes and garnish with fresh parsley.
Serve these flavorful Spanish Patatas Bravas as a delicious appetizer.

recipes.name: Vietnamese Fresh Spring Rolls
ingredients: Rice paper wrappers
Shrimp, cooked and sliced
Rice vermicelli, cooked
Lettuce leaves
Carrots, julienned
Cucumber, julienned
Fresh mint leaves
Peanut dipping sauce
instructions: Dip rice paper wrappers in warm water to soften.
Lay a wrapper on a flat surface and fill with shrimp, rice vermicelli, lettuce, carrots, cucumber, and mint leaves.
Fold the sides of the wrapper and roll tightly to seal.
Serve these Vietnamese Fresh Spring Rolls with peanut dipping sauce.
Enjoy these light and refreshing rolls as a delightful appetizer or snack.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
ingredients: Quinoa, cooked
Cherry tomatoes, halved
Cucumber, diced
Kalamata olives, sliced
Red onion, finely chopped
Feta cheese, crumbled
Fresh parsley, chopped
Lemon vinaigrette dressing
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cooked quinoa, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olives, red onion, feta cheese, and parsley.
Drizzle with lemon vinaigrette dressing and toss to combine.
Chill before serving. This Mediterranean Quinoa Salad is perfect as a refreshing side dish.

recipes.name: Japanese Matcha Green Tea Ice Cream
ingredients: Heavy cream
Whole milk
Granulated sugar
Matcha green tea powder
Egg yolks
instructions: In a saucepan, heat heavy cream, whole milk, and granulated sugar until it begins to steam.
Whisk in matcha green tea powder until fully combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk egg yolks. Slowly pour the hot milk mixture into the yolks, whisking continuously.
Return the mixture to the saucepan and heat until it thickens. Do not boil.
Strain the mixture and let it cool. Churn in an ice cream maker according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Freeze until firm. Indulge in the creamy goodness of Japanese Matcha Green Tea Ice Cream!

recipes.name: Brazilian Chocolate Brigadeiros
ingredients: Sweetened condensed milk
Cocoa powder
Unsalted butter
Chocolate sprinkles
instructions: In a saucepan, combine sweetened condensed milk, cocoa powder, and unsalted butter.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and pulls away from the pan.
Let the mixture cool. Grease your hands with butter and roll into small balls.
Coat the brigadeiros in chocolate sprinkles.
These Brazilian Chocolate Brigadeiros are a delightful sweet treat!

recipes.name: Mexican Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: Chicken breasts, cooked and shredded
Corn tortillas
Enchilada sauce
Black beans, drained and rinsed
Corn kernels
Shredded Mexican cheese blend
Fresh cilantro, chopped
Sour cream for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, mix shredded chicken with black beans, corn, and chopped cilantro.
Fill each corn tortilla with the chicken mixture and roll tightly.
Place the rolled enchiladas in a baking dish, cover with enchilada sauce, and sprinkle with shredded cheese.
Bake until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream. Enjoy these delicious Mexican Chicken Enchiladas!

recipes.name: Thai Coconut Shrimp Curry
ingredients: Shrimp, peeled and deveined
Coconut milk
Red curry paste
Fish sauce
Sugar
Bell peppers, sliced
Zucchini, sliced
Fresh basil leaves
Jasmine rice for serving
instructions: In a pan, simmer coconut milk with red curry paste, fish sauce, and sugar.
Add sliced bell peppers and zucchini. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Add shrimp and cook until they turn pink and opaque.
Stir in fresh basil leaves.
Serve this Thai Coconut Shrimp Curry over jasmine rice for a flavorful meal.

recipes.name: Greek Spanakopita
ingredients: Phyllo dough
Spinach, chopped and cooked
Feta cheese, crumbled
Onions, finely chopped
Eggs
Olive oil
Dill, chopped
Salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, mix cooked chopped spinach with crumbled feta, chopped onions, beaten eggs, olive oil, dill, salt, and pepper.
Layer sheets of phyllo dough in a baking dish, brushing each layer with olive oil.
Spread the spinach and feta mixture over the phyllo layers.
Top with more phyllo layers, brushing each with olive oil.
Bake until golden brown. Slice and serve this delicious Greek Spanakopita!

recipes.name: Moroccan Couscous Salad
ingredients: Couscous, cooked
Chickpeas, cooked
Cherry tomatoes, halved
Cucumber, diced
Red onion, finely chopped
Fresh mint leaves, chopped
Feta cheese, crumbled
Lemon vinaigrette dressing
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cooked couscous, chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, mint leaves, and crumbled feta.
Drizzle with lemon vinaigrette dressing and toss to combine.
Chill before serving. This Moroccan Couscous Salad makes a refreshing side dish.

recipes.name: Classic Mojito
ingredients: Fresh mint leaves
Lime, cut into wedges
Granulated sugar
White rum
Club soda
Ice cubes
instructions: In a glass, muddle fresh mint leaves with granulated sugar and lime wedges to release the flavors.
Add white rum and stir well.
Fill the glass with ice cubes and top with club soda.
Stir gently and garnish with a sprig of mint.
Sip and enjoy the classic and refreshing taste of a Mojito!

recipes.name: Caprese Bruschetta
ingredients: Baguette, sliced
Tomatoes, diced
Fresh mozzarella, sliced
Fresh basil leaves
Balsamic glaze
Olive oil
Garlic, minced
Salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler.
Place baguette slices on a baking sheet and toast under the broiler until golden.
In a bowl, combine diced tomatoes, sliced fresh mozzarella, minced garlic, and chopped fresh basil.
Drizzle with olive oil, balsamic glaze, and season with salt and pepper.
Spoon the tomato and mozzarella mixture onto the toasted baguette slices.
Serve these delightful Caprese Bruschettas as a quick and tasty appetizer.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: Chicken breast, thinly sliced
Broccoli florets
Bell peppers, sliced
Carrots, julienned
Soy sauce
Teriyaki sauce
Sesame oil
Garlic, minced
Ginger, grated
Cooked rice for serving
instructions: In a wok or skillet, heat sesame oil and sauté minced garlic and grated ginger until fragrant.
Add thinly sliced chicken and cook until browned.
Stir in broccoli florets, sliced bell peppers, and julienned carrots. Cook until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Pour soy sauce and teriyaki sauce over the stir-fry. Toss to combine.
Serve this quick Teriyaki Chicken Stir-Fry over cooked rice for a delicious meal.

recipes.name: Mango Avocado Salsa
ingredients: Mango, diced
Avocado, diced
Red onion, finely chopped
Cilantro, chopped
Lime juice
Salt and pepper to taste
Tortilla chips for serving
instructions: In a bowl, combine diced mango, diced avocado, finely chopped red onion, and chopped cilantro.
Drizzle with fresh lime juice and season with salt and pepper. Toss gently to combine.
Serve this refreshing Mango Avocado Salsa with tortilla chips for a quick and tasty snack.

recipes.name: Shrimp and Asparagus Stir-Fry
ingredients: Shrimp, peeled and deveined
Asparagus spears, trimmed and cut into pieces
Soy sauce
Sesame oil
Garlic, minced
Ginger, grated
Red pepper flakes
Green onions, sliced
Cooked noodles or rice for serving
instructions: In a wok or skillet, heat sesame oil and sauté minced garlic, grated ginger, and red pepper flakes until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook until they turn pink and opaque.
Stir in asparagus pieces and cook until crisp-tender.
Pour soy sauce over the stir-fry and toss to combine.
Serve this quick Shrimp and Asparagus Stir-Fry over cooked noodles or rice.

recipes.name: Italian Margherita Pizza
ingredients: Pizza dough
Tomatoes, thinly sliced
Fresh mozzarella, sliced
Fresh basil leaves
Olive oil
Garlic, minced
Salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to the highest temperature your oven can go.
Roll out pizza dough on a floured surface and transfer to a pizza stone or baking sheet.
Brush the dough with olive oil and sprinkle minced garlic over the surface.
Arrange thinly sliced tomatoes and fresh mozzarella slices on the dough.
Bake until the crust is golden and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Top with fresh basil leaves and season with salt and pepper. Slice and serve this classic Margherita Pizza.

recipes.name: Pesto Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: Penne pasta
Basil pesto sauce
Cherry tomatoes, halved
Parmesan cheese, grated
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook penne pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a pan, warm basil pesto sauce. Add cooked pasta and toss to coat evenly.
Stir in halved cherry tomatoes and cook until they soften slightly.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Garnish with grated Parmesan cheese.
Serve this quick and flavorful Pesto Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes for a delicious meal.

recipes.name: Hawaiian Chicken Skewers
ingredients: Chicken breasts, cut into chunks
Pineapple chunks
Bell peppers, sliced
Red onion, cut into wedges
Soy sauce
Pineapple juice
Ketchup
Brown sugar
Garlic, minced
Wooden skewers, soaked in water
instructions: Preheat the grill or grill pan.
In a bowl, whisk together soy sauce, pineapple juice, ketchup, brown sugar, and minced garlic to make the marinade.
Thread chicken chunks, pineapple chunks, bell pepper slices, and red onion wedges onto soaked wooden skewers.
Brush the skewers with the marinade and grill until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve these Hawaiian Chicken Skewers with rice or as a tasty appetizer.

recipes.name: Cucumber Avocado Rolls
ingredients: Sushi rice, seasoned
Nori sheets
Cucumber, julienned
Avocado, sliced
Soy sauce for dipping
Pickled ginger and wasabi for serving
instructions: Place a sheet of nori on a bamboo sushi rolling mat.
Spread seasoned sushi rice evenly over the nori, leaving a small border at the top.
Arrange julienned cucumber and sliced avocado along the bottom edge of the rice.
Roll the nori tightly from the bottom, using the bamboo mat to shape the roll.
Slice the roll into bite-sized pieces. Serve these refreshing Cucumber Avocado Rolls with soy sauce, pickled ginger, and wasabi.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
ingredients: Canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed
Cherry tomatoes, halved
Cucumber, diced
Red onion, finely chopped
Kalamata olives, sliced
Feta cheese, crumbled
Olive oil
Lemon juice
Dried oregano
Salt and pepper to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, olives, and feta cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, dried oregano, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.
Chill before serving. Enjoy this quick and refreshing Mediterranean Chickpea Salad.

recipes.name: Pineapple Coconut Smoothie
ingredients: Pineapple chunks, fresh or frozen
Coconut milk
Greek yogurt
Banana, peeled and sliced
Honey
Ice cubes
instructions: In a blender, combine pineapple chunks, coconut milk, Greek yogurt, banana, and honey.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Add ice cubes and blend again until the smoothie is chilled.
Pour into a glass and enjoy the tropical goodness of this Pineapple Coconut Smoothie!

recipes.name: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
ingredients: 800g boneless chicken thighs cut into bite-sized pieces
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp lemon juice
2 tbsp garam masala
1 tbsp ground cumin
1 tbsp turmeric powder
2 tbsp butter
1 cup heavy cream
2 cups canned crushed tomatoes
4 cloves minced garlic and 1 inch minced ginger
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, and spices for at least 30 minutes.
Sear marinated chicken in a hot skillet until slightly charred, about 6-8 minutes.
Melt butter in a large pot, sauté aromatics, add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Puree the sauce until silky smooth, then stir in heavy cream and chicken.
Simmer on low heat for 10 minutes until chicken is tender. Garnish with cilantro and serve with warm garlic naan.

recipes.name: Paneer Tikka Masala
ingredients: 400g fresh paneer cubes
1 large red bell pepper diced
1 large red onion diced
1 cup thick yogurt
1 tbsp Kashmiri chili powder
1 tsp kasuri methi (fenugreek leaves)
1.5 cups tomato puree
1/2 cup fresh cream
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
instructions: Marinate paneer, bell pepper, and onions in yogurt and spices for 20 minutes.
Roast the paneer and veggies in the oven or on a grill pan until golden edges appear.
Cook ginger garlic paste and tomato puree in butter with ground spices until oil separates.
Fold in the roasted paneer cubes and finish with heavy cream and kasuri methi.

recipes.name: Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
ingredients: 750g chicken pieces with bone
2.5 cups aged Basmati rice
1 cup crispy fried onions (birista)
1/2 cup mint leaves and 1/2 cup cilantro
1 tbsp whole spices (cardamom, cloves, bay leaf, cinnamon)
1/2 cup warm milk infused with saffron strands
3 tbsp ghee
1 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, chili powder, mint, fried onions, and whole spices for 1 hour.
Parboil Basmati rice in salted water with whole spices until 70% cooked; drain.
Layer marinated chicken at the bottom of a heavy pot, top with parboiled rice, fried onions, and saffron milk.
Seal pot tightly with foil and lid, cook on low flame (dum) for 35 minutes.
Fluff gently and serve with cold cucumber raita.

recipes.name: Dal Makhani
ingredients: 1 cup whole black urad dal soaked overnight
1/4 cup kidney beans (rajma) soaked overnight
3 tbsp butter
1/4 cup heavy cream
1 cup finely pureed tomatoes
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
1 tsp red chili powder
1 tsp garam masala
instructions: Pressure cook soaked lentils and beans with salt and water until completely soft.
In a saucepan, sauté ginger garlic paste in butter, add tomato puree and ground chili.
Add cooked lentils and simmer on low heat for 45 minutes, mashing slightly for a creamy texture.
Stir in cream, butter, and garam masala right before serving with hot rotis.

recipes.name: Chole Bhature
ingredients: 2 cups dried chickpeas soaked overnight
2 black tea bags for dark color
2 cups all-purpose flour
1/4 cup semolina (sooji)
1/2 cup yogurt
2 finely chopped onions and 2 tomatoes pureed
2 tbsp chole masala powder
Oil for deep frying
instructions: Boil chickpeas with tea bags and whole spices until very tender; discard tea bags.
Knead flour, semolina, yogurt, and a pinch of baking powder into a soft dough; rest 2 hours.
Sauté onions, tomatoes, and chole masala, then simmer chickpeas for 20 minutes until thick.
Roll dough into ovals and deep fry in piping hot oil until puffed like golden balloons.

recipes.name: Palak Paneer
ingredients: 500g fresh spinach leaves blanched
250g paneer cubes lightly sautéed
1 medium onion finely chopped
2 green chilies
1/2 cup cream
1 tsp cumin seeds
3 cloves garlic minced
instructions: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes, shock in ice water, and blend into a bright green puree.
Heat ghee in a pan, add cumin, chopped garlic, and onions until translucent.
Stir in spinach puree and spices; simmer gently on low heat for 5 minutes.
Gently fold in paneer cubes and finish with a swirl of heavy cream.

recipes.name: Samosas with Mint Chutney
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour
4 boiled and mashed potatoes
1/2 cup green peas
1 tbsp ajwain seeds
1 tsp amchur (dry mango powder)
1 tsp cumin and coriander seeds crushed
Oil for deep frying
instructions: Make a stiff dough with flour, ajwain, salt, oil, and chilled water; rest 30 minutes.
Sauté cumin, coriander, mashed potatoes, peas, and amchur for the spiced filling.
Roll dough into cones, fill with potato mixture, and seal edges with water.
Slow fry in medium heat oil until deeply golden and flaky.

recipes.name: Goan Fish Curry
ingredients: 500g kingfish or sea bass fillets
1 cup freshly grated coconut
1 cup thick coconut milk
4 dried Kashmiri red chilies
2 pieces dried kokum or tamarind paste
1 tsp coriander seeds
4 cloves garlic and 1 green chili slit
instructions: Blend coconut, dried red chilies, garlic, and coriander seeds into a smooth paste.
Heat coconut oil in an earthenware pot, add paste and sauté until aromatic.
Add kokum, coconut milk, and bring to a gentle boil.
Slide in fish fillets and simmer gently for 6-8 minutes until cooked through. Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
ingredients: 500g diced chicken breast
1/2 cup roasted unsalted peanuts
8 whole dried red chilies
1 tsp Sichuan peppercorns
3 green onions sliced into 1-inch lengths
2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp dark soy sauce
1 tbsp Chinese black vinegar
1 tbsp cornstarch
instructions: Marinate chicken in soy sauce, Shaoxing cooking wine, and cornstarch for 15 minutes.
Mix soy sauce, black vinegar, sugar, broth, and cornstarch in a small bowl for the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok until smoking, fry dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns until fragrant.
Add chicken and sear quickly, then toss in green onions, peanuts, and sauce until glossy.

recipes.name: Dim Sum Steamed Pork Siu Mai
ingredients: 300g ground pork with some fat
150g peeled shrimp chopped coarsely
4 dried shiitake mushrooms rehydrated and minced
24 square wonton wrappers cut into circles
1 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tsp sesame oil
Grated carrot or tobiko for garnish
instructions: Combine pork, shrimp, mushrooms, oyster sauce, sesame oil, and white pepper in a bowl.
Vigorously stir in one direction until the mixture becomes sticky and cohesive.
Cup wrapper in your hand, fill with 1 generous tbsp of filling, squeeze into an open-topped basket shape.
Garnish with a pinch of grated carrot and steam in a bamboo steamer for 10-12 minutes.

recipes.name: Mapo Tofu
ingredients: 1 block (400g) soft silken tofu cut into cubes
100g minced beef or pork
2 tbsp Sichuan doubanjiang (fermented chili bean paste)
1 tbsp fermented black beans (douchi)
1 tsp ground Sichuan pepper
2 cloves garlic minced
1 cup chicken broth
2 tbsp cornstarch slurry
instructions: Simmer tofu cubes in salted hot water for 2 minutes to strengthen, drain gently.
Brown minced meat in a wok with oil until crisp; add doubanjiang and garlic until oil turns red.
Pour in chicken stock, slide in tofu cubes, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Drizzle in cornstarch slurry in three stages until thick, finish with ground Sichuan pepper.

recipes.name: Classic Cantonese Char Siu (BBQ Pork)
ingredients: 1kg pork shoulder or pork collar cut into long strips
2 tbsp hoisin sauce
2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp dark soy sauce
1 tbsp fermented red bean curd (for classic red hue)
1 tsp Chinese five-spice powder
instructions: Whisk together all marinade ingredients and coat pork strips thoroughly; refrigerate overnight.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) with a water-filled tray on the lower rack.
Roast pork on a wire rack for 25 minutes, baste generously with glaze, flip and roast 20 minutes more.
Brush with maltose honey glaze and broil for 2-3 minutes until edges are caramelized and charred.

recipes.name: Beef Chow Fun
ingredients: 400g fresh wide flat rice noodles (ho fun)
200g flank steak thinly sliced across the grain
1 cup fresh mung bean sprouts
3 scallions cut into sections
1.5 tbsp dark soy sauce and 1 tbsp light soy sauce
1 tbsp Shaoxing wine and cornstarch for beef marinade
instructions: Marinate sliced beef in soy sauce, wine, and cornstarch for 15 minutes.
Sear beef in a searing hot wok with oil until just browned, set aside.
Add noodles to the wok and stir-fry gently without breaking them, drizzling soy sauce evenly.
Return beef, add bean sprouts and green onions, toss vigorously for 1 minute for true wok hei.

recipes.name: Authentic Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients: 400g spaghetti bronze-die cut
200g guanciale or pancetta sliced into strips
4 fresh large egg yolks + 1 whole egg
1 cup freshly grated Pecorino Romano cheese
Abundant freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: Boil spaghetti in generously salted water until al dente.
In a dry skillet, crisp the guanciale over medium heat until golden and fat has rendered.
In a bowl, whisk egg yolks, whole egg, Pecorino cheese, and black pepper into a paste.
Toss hot drained pasta in the pan with guanciale fat off heat, then quickly stir in egg cheese mixture with 1/4 cup pasta water until creamy.

recipes.name: Osso Buco alla Milanese
ingredients: 4 thick-cut veal shanks with marrow bone intact
1 cup dry white wine
2 cups rich beef broth
1 finely diced onion, 1 carrot, 1 celery rib (soffritto)
2 tbsp tomato paste
Gremolata: grated lemon zest, minced flat-leaf parsley, 1 clove garlic
instructions: Tie butcher string around shanks, season with salt and dust lightly with flour.
Sear shanks in olive oil and butter in a Dutch oven until deep golden on both sides; remove.
Sauté soffritto, deglaze with white wine, stir in tomato paste and stock.
Return shanks, cover tightly, braise in 325°F (165°C) oven for 1.5 hours until fork-tender. Top with gremolata.

recipes.name: Tiramisu Tradizionale
ingredients: 500g mascarpone cheese at room temperature
4 fresh large eggs separated
1/2 cup granulated sugar
1.5 cups strong brewed espresso cooled
2 tbsp Marsala wine or dark rum
30 Italian savoiardi (ladyfinger cookies)
Unsweetened Dutch-process cocoa powder for dusting
instructions: Whip egg yolks with sugar until pale and thick; fold in creamy mascarpone until velvety.
Beat egg whites to stiff peaks and gently fold into the mascarpone cream.
Quickly dip ladyfingers into espresso mixed with Marsala wine.
Layer dipped ladyfingers and cream in a dish, repeat layers, and chill for 6 hours. Dust with cocoa before slicing.

recipes.name: Risotto ai Funghi Porcini
ingredients: 300g Carnaroli or Arborio rice
30g dried porcini mushrooms soaked in 2 cups warm water
200g fresh mixed wild mushrooms sliced
1 finely minced shallot
1/2 cup dry white wine
4 cups hot vegetable or chicken broth
50g cold butter cubed and 1/2 cup Parmigiano Reggiano
instructions: Strain soaking liquid from porcini and combine with broth; keep at a simmer.
Sauté shallot in olive oil, add rice and toast for 2 minutes until translucent.
Deglaze with white wine, then ladle hot broth gradually, stirring continuously.
Sauté fresh mushrooms in butter; fold into risotto after 18 minutes. Mantecare off heat with cold butter and Parmigiano.

recipes.name: Birria Tacos with Consomé
ingredients: 1.5kg beef chuck roast and short ribs
4 dried guajillo chilies and 3 dried ancho chilies deseeded
1 dried chipotle chili
1 white onion and 5 cloves garlic
1 tsp Mexican oregano and 1 cinnamon stick
Corn tortillas and shredded Oaxaca cheese
Diced onion and fresh cilantro for serving
instructions: Toast dried chilies lightly, rehydrate in hot water, and blend with garlic, onion, spices, and vinegar into an adobo.
Sear beef chunks in a Dutch oven, pour adobo and beef broth over meat, and braise for 2.5 hours until shreds easily.
Shred meat and strain the rich, savory broth (consomé) into a bowl.
Dip tortillas in the fat layer of the consomé, griddle with cheese and shredded beef, fold until crispy, and serve with consomé for dipping.

recipes.name: Enchiladas Verdes Suizas
ingredients: 12 corn tortillas
3 cups shredded cooked rotisserie chicken
500g fresh tomatillos husked
2 serrano peppers
1/2 cup Mexican crema or sour cream
1/2 cup fresh cilantro
2 cups shredded Chihuahua or Monterey Jack cheese
instructions: Boil tomatillos and serranos for 8 minutes; blend with garlic, onion, cilantro, and crema until velvety.
Lightly pass corn tortillas through hot oil to soften.
Roll tortillas with shredded chicken, arrange snuggly in a baking dish, and cover with warm salsa verde.
Top with generous cheese and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15 minutes until bubbly and golden.

recipes.name: Guacamole Auténtico & Totopos
ingredients: 3 ripe Hass avocados
1/2 cup finely diced white onion
1 minced jalapeño or serrano pepper
1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
Juice of 2 fresh limes
Coarse sea salt to taste
Crispy fried corn tortilla chips (totopos)
instructions: In a molcajete or bowl, grind diced onion, chili, and salt into a coarse paste.
Halve avocados, remove pit, and scoop flesh into the bowl.
Coarsely mash with a fork, retaining chunky texture.
Gently fold in fresh lime juice and cilantro, taste for salt, and serve immediately with totopos.

recipes.name: Chiles Rellenos
ingredients: 4 large fresh poblano peppers
250g Queso Oaxaca or Asadero cut into sticks
3 large eggs separated
1/2 cup flour for dusting
2 cups roasted tomato and caldillo sauce
Neutral oil for shallow frying
instructions: Char poblanos over open flame until skin is blistered and blackened; steam in a covered bowl, then peel.
Cut a small slit down one side, remove seeds carefully, and stuff tightly with cheese.
Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form, then gently fold in beaten yolks.
Dust stuffed peppers with flour, dip into egg batter, and fry in hot oil until golden brown on all sides. Serve over warm tomato caldillo.

recipes.name: Southern Buttermilk Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken cut into 8 pieces
2 cups cultured buttermilk
2 cups all-purpose flour
1 tbsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper
1 tbsp garlic powder and 1 tbsp onion powder
1 tbsp kosher salt and freshly ground pepper
Peanut or vegetable oil for deep frying
instructions: Submerge chicken pieces in seasoned buttermilk and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight.
Whisk flour with paprika, cayenne, garlic powder, onion powder, and seasonings.
Dredge chicken from buttermilk into seasoned flour, press coating firmly on pieces.
Fry in 350°F (175°C) oil for 14-16 minutes until internal temperature hits 165°F and crust is deeply crispy.

recipes.name: Classic New England Clam Chowder
ingredients: 3 cups fresh or canned minced clams with juice
4 slices thick-cut bacon diced
2 large Russet potatoes peeled and diced
1 medium yellow onion finely chopped
2 stalks celery diced
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
1.5 cups heavy cream
2 fresh thyme sprigs and 1 bay leaf
instructions: Cook diced bacon in a heavy pot until crisp; drain bacon and reserve drippings.
Sauté onions and celery in bacon drippings until soft, sprinkle flour and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in clam juice and add diced potatoes with thyme; simmer 15 minutes until potatoes are fork tender.
Stir in minced clams and heavy cream; heat through gently without boiling. Serve with oyster crackers.

recipes.name: Smoked Texas Beef Brisket
ingredients: 5kg whole packer beef brisket trimmed with 1/4 inch fat cap
1/3 cup coarse kosher salt (Dalmatian rub)
1/3 cup coarse butcher grind black pepper
1 tbsp garlic powder
Post oak wood chunks for smoking
Unwaxed butcher paper for wrapping
instructions: Trim excess hard fat and silver skin, leaving an even quarter-inch fat layer.
Coat brisket generously with equal parts kosher salt and coarse black pepper.
Smoke at 225°F-250°F (110°C-120°C) with oak wood for 6 hours until dark bark forms.
Wrap tightly in butcher paper, return to smoker until internal temp reaches 203°F (95°C), and rest for 2 hours before slicing.

recipes.name: New York Style Baked Cheesecake
ingredients: 900g full-fat cream cheese at room temperature
1 cup granulated sugar
4 large eggs at room temperature
1/2 cup sour cream
1 tbsp vanilla bean paste
1.5 cups Graham cracker crumbs and 4 tbsp melted butter
instructions: Press graham cracker crumbs and butter into bottom of a 9-inch springform pan, pre-bake 10 minutes at 350°F.
Beat cream cheese and sugar on low speed until smooth; incorporate eggs one at a time.
Fold in sour cream and vanilla paste; pour batter over cooled crust.
Bake in a water bath at 325°F (160°C) for 65 minutes until center wobbles slightly. Cool gradually in oven with door propped.

recipes.name: Tokyo Tonkotsu Ramen
ingredients: 1.5kg pork femur and neck bones soaked and blanched
4 portions fresh alkaline ramen noodles
4 slices rolled chashu pork belly
2 soft-boiled marinated ramen eggs (ajitsuke tamago)
2 sheets nori seaweed cut in half
1/4 cup tare (concentrated soy seasoning sauce)
Sliced scallions and menma (bamboo shoots)
instructions: Boil cleaned pork bones on high heat for 6-8 hours until broth turns milky white and rich in collagen.
Marinate soft-boiled 6-minute eggs in soy sauce, mirin, and dashi overnight.
Boil fresh ramen noodles for 90 seconds until firm.
Ladle hot tare and steaming tonkotsu broth into bowls, add noodles, and arrange chashu, halved egg, scallions, and nori.

recipes.name: Authentic Nigiri & Sashimi Platter
ingredients: 2 cups premium Japanese short-grain rice (sushi rice)
3 tbsp seasoned rice vinegar
200g sashimi-grade salmon fillet sliced
200g sashimi-grade bluefin tuna fillet sliced
Real wasabi paste
Pickled ginger (gari) and artisanal soy sauce
instructions: Rinse sushi rice thoroughly, cook with dashi kombu, and season with sushi vinegar while fanning.
Slice chilled sashimi fish across the grain at a 45-degree angle.
Shape 20g of seasoned sushi rice into an oblong mound in palm, add a dab of wasabi, and drape fish slice over rice.
Serve immediately with fresh wasabi and pickled ginger.

recipes.name: Crispy Chicken Katsu Curry
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts pounded to even thickness
2 cups Japanese panko breadcrumbs
2 large eggs beaten and 1/2 cup flour
1 box Japanese curry roux blocks
1 large onion sliced, 2 carrots chopped, 2 potatoes cubed
Steamed short-grain rice for serving
instructions: Sauté onions until deeply caramelized, add carrots, potatoes, and water; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in curry blocks until dissolved and simmer into a thick, glossy curry sauce.
Dredge chicken in flour, dip in egg, and coat thoroughly in panko breadcrumbs.
Deep fry at 340°F (170°C) until golden brown and crispy; slice and plate alongside rice and curry sauce.

recipes.name: Traditional Pad Thai Kung
ingredients: 200g dried flat rice noodles soaked in room temperature water for 1 hour
10 large tiger prawns peeled and deveined
1 block firm pressed tofu cut into batons
2 large eggs
3 tbsp tamarind paste concentrate
2 tbsp fish sauce and 2 tbsp palm sugar
Fresh bean sprouts, Chinese chives, crushed roasted peanuts, lime wedges
instructions: Melt palm sugar with tamarind paste and fish sauce in a small pot to make balanced pad thai sauce.
Heat oil in a wok, fry tofu and prawns until cooked, push aside and scramble eggs.
Add drained soaked noodles and pad thai sauce, stir-fry rapidly until noodles absorb sauce and soften.
Toss with bean sprouts and Chinese chives for 30 seconds; plate with crushed peanuts and lime.

recipes.name: Tom Yum Goong
ingredients: 500g fresh head-on shrimp
4 cups rich shrimp stock
3 stalks fresh lemongrass bruised and sliced
6 fresh kaffir lime leaves torn
1 thumb-sized galangal root sliced
5 bird's eye chilies crushed
200g straw mushrooms or oyster mushrooms
3 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1 tbsp Thai roasted chili paste (nam prik pao)
instructions: Bring shrimp stock to a rolling boil with lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves.
Add chili paste, crushed chilies, and mushrooms, simmering for 3 minutes.
Drop in shrimp and cook for 2 minutes until pink and curled.
Remove from heat, stir in fish sauce and lime juice, and garnish with fresh cilantro.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry (Gaeng Kiew Wan Gai)
ingredients: 500g chicken thighs cut into pieces
3 tbsp authentic Thai green curry paste
1.5 cans (600ml) full-fat coconut milk
1 cup Thai pea eggplants and round eggplants quartered
1 cup fresh Thai sweet basil leaves
2 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp palm sugar
4 kaffir lime leaves torn
instructions: Heat 1/2 cup of coconut cream in a pan until it separates and oil cracks.
Fry green curry paste in the coconut oil for 3 minutes until wonderfully fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and coat with paste, then pour in remaining coconut milk.
Add eggplants and lime leaves, simmer 10 minutes until chicken is cooked. Stir in basil and fish sauce off heat.

recipes.name: Pakistani Beef Nihari
ingredients: 1.2kg beef shank with bone marrow (nalli)
1/2 cup ghee
2 tbsp ginger garlic paste
2 tbsp homemade Nihari spice masala (fennel, mace, nutmeg, star anise)
1/4 cup roasted whole wheat flour dissolved in water
Garnish: julienned fresh ginger, chopped green chilies, cilantro, and lemon wedges
instructions: Heat ghee in a heavy pot, brown beef shanks with ginger garlic paste.
Add Nihari spice blend and sauté for 3 minutes until aromatic.
Pour in 6 cups of water, cover tightly, and simmer on very low heat for 4 hours until meat melts.
Slowly pour in wheat flour slurry while stirring to thicken into a velvety gravy. Serve with hot Roghani naan.

recipes.name: Lahori Chargha (Steamed & Fried Chicken)
ingredients: 1 whole skinless chicken with deep cuts across breasts and legs
1 cup thick yogurt
2 tbsp lemon juice
1 tbsp chaat masala
1 tbsp red chili flakes and cumin seeds
1 tsp orange food color (optional)
Oil for flash frying
instructions: Rub chicken with yogurt, lemon juice, and ground Lahori spices; marinate 4 hours.
Steam marinated whole chicken in a steamer basket for 25 minutes until cooked through.
Let cool slightly to dry surface moisture.
Flash fry in hot oil for 4-5 minutes until deeply crispy. Dust generously with chaat masala.

recipes.name: Traditional Greek Moussaka
ingredients: 3 large eggplants sliced into 1/2 inch rounds
3 large Yukon gold potatoes peeled and sliced
600g ground lamb or beef
1 cup tomato passata and 1 cinnamon stick
3 cups creamy bechamel sauce enriched with egg yolks and nutmeg
1 cup grated Kefalotyri or Parmesan cheese
instructions: Brush eggplant and potato slices with olive oil, roast at 400°F (200°C) until tender and golden.
Simmer ground lamb with onions, garlic, cinnamon stick, red wine, and tomato sauce for 30 minutes.
Layer potatoes at the bottom of a baking dish, followed by roasted eggplants and the meat sauce.
Pour silky bechamel over top, scatter cheese, and bake for 45 minutes until golden brown and puffed.

recipes.name: Authentic Greek Salad (Horiatiki)
ingredients: 4 ripe vine tomatoes cut into wedges
1 crisp English cucumber sliced into half moons
1/2 red onion thinly sliced
1 green bell pepper sliced
1 block (200g) real Greek sheep milk feta cheese
1/2 cup Kalamata olives
Extra virgin Greek olive oil and dried wild oregano
instructions: Combine tomatoes, cucumber, onion, bell pepper, and Kalamata olives in a shallow bowl.
Place the whole slab of feta cheese right on top.
Generously drizzle with rich olive oil and sprinkle with fragrant dried oregano.
Serve with crusty rustic bread to soak up the juices.

recipes.name: Paella de Marisco (Seafood Paella)
ingredients: 400g Bomba or Calasparra rice
12 large jumbo prawns with shells on
300g fresh mussels and clams scrubbed
200g calamari rings
5 cups rich fish and shellfish stock infused with saffron threads
1 grated tomato, 1 diced red bell pepper, and 3 cloves garlic (sofrito)
1 tsp sweet Spanish pimentón (paprika)
instructions: Sear prawns and squid in olive oil in a wide paella pan; remove.
Sauté sofrito with grated tomato, garlic, bell pepper, and sweet paprika.
Add Bomba rice, toast lightly, and distribute evenly across pan; pour in hot saffron stock.
Simmer without stirring for 18 minutes; arrange seafood on top until shells open and a crispy bottom crust (socarrat) forms.

recipes.name: Spanish Tapas: Gambas al Ajillo
ingredients: 500g raw shrimp peeled and deveined
8 cloves garlic thinly sliced
1/2 cup Spanish extra virgin olive oil
1 dried cayenne chili pepper sliced
2 tbsp dry sherry or white wine
Handful chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley and crusty bread
instructions: Heat olive oil in a cazuela or skillet over medium heat.
Add sliced garlic and dried chili, cooking gently until garlic is golden and aromatic.
Increase heat, toss in shrimp and cook for 2 minutes until pink.
Splash in sherry, season with sea salt, sprinkle parsley, and serve sizzling hot with bread for dipping.

recipes.name: Korean Bibimbap with Crispy Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked short-grain rice
150g thinly sliced beef marinated in soy, sesame oil, and garlic
1 cup blanched seasoned spinach
1 cup seasoned bean sprouts
1 carrot julienned and sautéed
2 fresh eggs (sunny-side up or raw yolk)
2 tbsp gochujang paste mixed with sesame oil, vinegar, and sugar
instructions: Sauté each seasoned vegetable individually with a drop of sesame oil.
Quickly sear marinated beef in a hot skillet.
In a hot stone bowl (dolsot) coated with sesame oil, pack rice until bottom forms a crispy crust.
Arrange vegetables and beef in neat color sections over rice, top with egg and gochujang sauce.

recipes.name: Korean Fried Chicken (Yangnyeom)
ingredients: 1kg chicken wings and drumettes
3/4 cup potato starch or cornstarch
1/4 cup gochujang (Korean chili paste)
1/4 cup honey or corn syrup
2 tbsp ketchup, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp soy sauce
Toasted white sesame seeds and chopped peanuts
instructions: Season wings with salt, pepper, and minced ginger; coat thoroughly in potato starch.
First fry at 330°F (165°C) for 10 minutes; drain and cool.
Simmer gochujang, honey, ketchup, soy sauce, and garlic into a glossy, sticky glaze.
Double-fry wings at 375°F (190°C) for 5 minutes until shatteringly crisp; toss immediately in sticky glaze.

recipes.name: Traditional Vietnamese Pho Bo
ingredients: 1.5kg beef marrow and knuckle bones blanched
300g beef brisket and 200g thinly sliced raw eye of round
Charred aromatics: 1 onion and 1 piece ginger halved and charred
Spices toasted: star anise, cinnamon stick, black cardamom, cloves, coriander seeds
400g flat pho rice noodles
Fish sauce, rock sugar, Thai basil, bean sprouts, lime, and sliced jalapeños
instructions: Simmer blanched beef bones, charred onion, ginger, and toasted spices gently for 5 hours.
Season broth with Vietnamese fish sauce and rock sugar until deeply aromatic and clear.
Cook flat rice noodles, divide into bowls, and top with cooked brisket and raw beef slices.
Pour boiling broth over raw beef to cook it instantly; serve with herbs, lime, and bean sprouts.

recipes.name: Vietnamese Banh Mi Sandwich
ingredients: 2 Vietnamese baguettes with crisp crust and airy crumb
200g grilled marinated lemongrass pork slices
2 tbsp French liver pâté and 2 tbsp mayonnaise
Pickled daikon and carrots (do chua)
Fresh cucumber spears, jalapeño slices, and cilantro sprigs
Maggi seasoning sauce
instructions: Grill seasoned pork until caramelized and smoky.
Split warm, crispy baguettes lengthwise and spread with liver pâté and mayonnaise.
Layer grilled pork, cucumber spears, sweet and tangy pickled vegetables, and cilantro.
Drizzle with a few drops of Maggi seasoning and fresh chili slices.

recipes.name: Turkish Adana Kebab
ingredients: 600g ground lamb with 20% tail fat
1 red bell pepper finely minced and squeezed dry
2 cloves garlic minced
1.5 tbsp Turkish red pepper flakes (pul biber)
1 tsp ground cumin and salt
Sumac onions, grilled peppers, and lavash flatbreads for serving
instructions: Knead minced lamb, red pepper, garlic, and pul biber vigorously until protein binds and mixture is sticky.
Mold kebab mixture onto wide flat metal skewers in waves using wet hands.
Grill over hot lump charcoal for 8-10 minutes, turning skewers frequently.
Slide off skewer directly into warm lavash bread with sumac-dusted onions and roasted tomatoes.

recipes.name: Authentic Turkish Baklava
ingredients: 1 package (500g) paper-thin phyllo dough sheets
300g premium Antep pistachios finely chopped
250g clarified butter (ghee) melted
Syrup: 2 cups sugar, 1.5 cups water, 1 tbsp lemon juice
instructions: Simmer sugar, water, and lemon juice for 15 minutes to make syrup; allow to cool completely.
Layer 20 sheets of phyllo in a baking pan, brushing each layer with melted clarified butter.
Spread chopped pistachios evenly across the pastry, then layer 20 more buttered phyllo sheets.
Cut into diamond shapes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 45 minutes until golden. Pour cold syrup over hot baklava.

recipes.name: Authentic Lebanese Shish Tawook
ingredients: 800g chicken breast cut into cubes
1/2 cup plain yogurt
6 cloves crushed garlic
2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tbsp lemon juice
1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 1/2 tsp cardamom
Authentic toum (creamy garlic sauce) and pita bread
instructions: Whisk yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, tomato paste, olive oil, and spices.
Marinate chicken cubes for at least 4 hours.
Thread onto skewers and grill over charcoal or broil for 12-14 minutes until juicy and slightly charred.
Wrap in warm Lebanese pita bread with plenty of toum and pickled cucumbers.

recipes.name: Classic Hummus Bil Tahina
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chickpeas with skins gently removed
1/2 cup pure Ethiopian tahini paste
1/4 cup freshly squeezed lemon juice
2 cloves garlic
3 tbsp ice water for fluffiness
Extra virgin olive oil and sumac for garnish
instructions: Puree garlic, lemon juice, and salt in a food processor until smooth.
Add tahini and stream in ice water while processing until pale and whipped.
Add warm chickpeas and blend for 4-5 minutes until ultra-velvety and smooth.
Spoon into a shallow dish, create swirling wells, drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and dust with sumac.

recipes.name: Moroccan Lamb & Prune Tagine
ingredients: 800g lamb shoulder chunks
1.5 cups pitted dried sweet prunes
1 large onion finely grated
1 tbsp Ras el Hanout spice blend
Pinch of saffron threads
1 tsp ground cinnamon and 2 tbsp honey
Toasted blanched almonds and sesame seeds for topping
instructions: Brown lamb chunks in olive oil inside a clay tagine or heavy pot.
Add grated onions, Ras el Hanout, saffron, ginger, and stock; cover and simmer for 1 hour.
Simmer prunes separately with a ladle of tagine broth, cinnamon, and honey until caramelized.
Arrange glossy prunes over tender lamb, sprinkle with toasted almonds and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Traditional Brazilian Feijoada
ingredients: 500g dried black beans soaked overnight
300g smoked sausage (Carne Seca or linguiça)
300g pork ribs and bacon chunks
4 cloves garlic minced and 1 large onion chopped
3 bay leaves and 1 fresh orange halved
Served with white rice, farofa (toasted cassava flour), and sautéed collard greens
instructions: Cook soaked black beans in fresh water with bay leaves and halved orange.
Brown bacon, ribs, and smoked sausages in a separate pan; transfer meats to beans pot.
Simmer gently for 2.5 to 3 hours until beans are rich and creamy and meats are fork tender.
Sauté minced garlic in lard, add a ladle of mashed beans to emulsify, and stir back into stew.

recipes.name: Pão de Queijo (Brazilian Cheese Bread)
ingredients: 2 cups tapioca starch (polvilho doce)
1 cup whole milk
1/2 cup vegetable oil or butter
1.5 cups grated Queijo Minas or Parmesan cheese
2 large eggs
1 tsp salt
instructions: Scald milk, oil, and salt in a saucepan; pour hot liquid over tapioca starch and mix until dough cools.
Beat in eggs one at a time until dough is smooth and glossy.
Fold in grated cheese thoroughly.
Roll into 1-inch balls with oiled hands, bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.

recipes.name: Classic Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 600g beef tenderloin or sirloin cut into thin strips
250g cremini mushrooms sliced
1 medium onion thinly sliced
1 cup rich beef stock
3/4 cup real sour cream (smetana)
1 tbsp Dijon mustard and 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
Butter and buttered egg noodles for serving
instructions: Sear beef strips in bubbling butter in a screaming hot skillet for 2 minutes; set aside immediately.
Sauté onions and mushrooms in the same pan until caramelized and golden.
Deglaze with beef stock, simmer with Dijon mustard and Worcestershire for 5 minutes.
Stir in sour cream on gentle heat, return beef and resting juices for 1 minute; serve over egg noodles.

recipes.name: Traditional Ukrainian-Russian Borscht
ingredients: 3 medium fresh red beets grated
300g beef bone-in shank
2 cups shredded green cabbage
2 potatoes diced and 1 carrot grated
1 tbsp tomato paste and 1 tbsp vinegar for bright color
Fresh dill and sour cream (smetana) for serving
instructions: Simmer beef shank in water to make a clear, rich broth; skim foam.
Sauté grated beets with vinegar, tomato paste, and a splash of broth to retain vibrant crimson color.
Add potatoes and shredded cabbage to the broth; cook for 15 minutes.
Stir in sautéed beets, garlic, and dill; rest 20 minutes before ladling with dollops of sour cream.

recipes.name: Fresh Ahi Tuna Poke Bowl
ingredients: 400g sashimi-grade yellowfin tuna cut into 3/4 inch cubes
2 tbsp Japanese soy sauce (shoyu)
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1/4 cup sliced sweet Maui onion
2 scallions thinly sliced and 1 tsp Hawaiian sea salt
1 tsp toasted white and black sesame seeds
Steamed seasoned sushi rice and seaweed salad
instructions: Pat cubed Ahi tuna dry with paper towels.
In a chilled bowl, gently toss tuna with soy sauce, sesame oil, Hawaiian salt, Maui onions, and scallions.
Chill for 15 minutes to allow flavors to harmonize.
Scoop warm rice into bowls, crown with marinated poke, avocado slices, and furikake.

recipes.name: Hawaiian Kalua Pork with Cabbage
ingredients: 2.5kg pork butt/shoulder roast
2 tbsp coarse Hawaiian red sea salt (Alaea)
2 tbsp liquid smoke
1 head green cabbage chopped into thick wedges
instructions: Pierce pork roast all over with a carving fork; rub thoroughly with Hawaiian salt and liquid smoke.
Slow cook on low for 8 hours (or braise in Dutch oven) until meat collapses into tender shreds.
Shred pork, add fresh cabbage wedges into the hot juices, cover and steam 15 minutes until tender-crisp.
Serve hot with steamed rice and macaroni salad.

recipes.name: Tropical Mango Passionfruit Smoothie
ingredients: 2 cups frozen ripe mango chunks
Pulp of 2 fresh passionfruits
1 frozen banana
1 cup unsweetened coconut water
1/2 cup Greek yogurt
1 tbsp chia seeds
instructions: Place coconut water and yogurt in high-speed blender first.
Add frozen mango, banana, and passionfruit pulp.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until frosty and velvety smooth.
Pour into tall chilled glasses and top with chia seeds.

recipes.name: Creamy Acai Superfood Power Bowl
ingredients: 100g pure unsweetened frozen acai packet
1/2 cup frozen mixed berries (blueberries, raspberries)
1 frozen ripe banana
1/4 cup almond milk
Toppings: artisan granola, sliced fresh strawberries, coconut flakes, raw honey drizzle
instructions: Break frozen acai packet into blender with frozen banana, berries, and almond milk.
Blend using tamper on low until a thick, soft-serve ice cream consistency forms.
Spoon into a chilled ceramic bowl.
Decorate neatly with sliced strawberries, blueberries, crunchy granola, and a ribbon of raw honey.

recipes.name: Classic Mint Mojito Fresco
ingredients: 10 fresh mint leaves
1/2 fresh lime cut into 4 wedges
2 tbsp pure cane sugar or simple syrup
2 oz white rum (or club soda for virgin mocktail)
1/2 cup crushed ice
Chilled sparkling club soda to top
instructions: Place mint leaves and lime wedges into a sturdy Collins glass.
Gently muddle to release essential oils without shredding mint leaves.
Fill glass with crushed ice and pour in white rum and syrup.
Top with club soda, churn gently with a bar spoon, and garnish with a spanked fresh mint sprig.
